operator_semantics.eq: strict JSON value equality; numeric 1 and 1.0 compare numerically equal; booleans are not numbers
operator_semantics.exists: JSON Pointer resolves to a value
operator_semantics.contains_all: all expected elements occur in actual collection under strict equality
operator_semantics.contains_none: no expected element occurs in actual collection under strict equality
operator_semantics.digest_eq: actual and expected are lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 strings and are byte-for-byte equal
operator_semantics.all: PASS iff every child PASS; FAIL iff any child FAIL; otherwise NOT_VERIFIED
operator_semantics.any: PASS iff any child PASS; FAIL iff every child FAIL; otherwise NOT_VERIFIED
